title: A Strong Little Anchor
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
One day poor Job lost what he had,
his animals and land;
His house was gone, he felt so sick,
he didn't understand.

[Chorus]
Even when something makes you sad,
you still can trust and pray;
God never leaves you, hold on tight,
He's with you all the way.

[Verse 2]
But even with his heavy heart,
Job bowed down low and said,
"I'll still trust Heavenly Father
through all the days ahead."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little one,
and rest your sleepy head;
Hold faith, a little anchor strong,
and God is near your bed.

[Chorus]
mood: Anchor music. A deep, slow rock moves under the voice, like a small boat held steady by its anchor while the waves pass by. The first two verses carry a heavy but hopeful sway, never sinking, always holding. By the last verse the rocking grows slower and lower still, until it is nearly motionless, safe and held for the night.
